'''Silver''' can refer to the following:

==Establishments==
* [[Garden of Silver Breezes]] - a wineshop in [[Tanchico]].
* [[Silver Circiut]] a racehorse track near [[Ebou Dar]].
* [[The Silver Swan]] - an [[inn]] in [[Caemlyn]].
* [[The Silver Penny]] - an inn in [[Chachin]].

==''[[Ter'angreal]]''==
* [[Silver ring]] - a [[sleepweaver]] ''ter'angreal''.
* [[Silver arches]] - a ''ter'angreal'' in the [[White Tower]].

==Chapter titles==
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 34|A Silver Arrow]]'' - the thirty-forth chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 9|A Pair of Silverpike]]'' - the ninth chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.

==Others==
* [[Measurement#Coinage|Silver]] - used in the making of coins.
* [[Silverleaf]] - an [[herb]] that, when combined with [[timsin root]], can treat headaches.
* [[Silverpike]] - a fish common in [[Tear]].
* [[Silver Road]] - a roadway linking the cities of [[Illian (city)|Illian]] and [[Lugard]].
* [[:Category:Silversmiths|Silversmiths]] - people who work and forge silver.
